name: gallery
title: Gallery
description: A set of picture tiles that open a full-screen viewer: a mosaic of one large and several small, an even grid, or a row that scrolls sideways.

meta.when: Showing several pictures of one thing where each can be looked at closely: a place, a product, a piece of work. GalleryLightbox takes a list of pictures and does everything; Gallery, GalleryItem and GalleryImage are the parts, to put inside your own Lightbox or to use with no viewer at all. Pictures are plain `` elements unless the project gives its framework's image component: `as` on GalleryImage, `renderImage` on GalleryLightbox. For pictures that are decoration, use plain images in a grid; for one picture use aspect.
